summary: Luzerne County, PA steel Aermotor tower built 1921 near Dallas, on Irem Temple Country Club grounds; newspaper-documented staffing 1930-1962; removed before 2005.

facts.status_note: Removed before 2005 per FFLOS; the Forest Lookouts page marks it removed; no source describes what remains at the site
facts.agency: Pennsylvania Department of Forests and Waters (its district office announced in 1948 that it would operate eight towers; the Harvey's listing does not say it was one of them)

staffing.status: Bill (William) Harlos in charge in 1953 and named operator in 1955; manned round the clock during a July 1962 dry spell

access.note: Stood on the Irem Temple Country Club grounds per a 1955 newspaper item; the club is now described as a private club. No source says whether the old tower site is part of the course or open to visitors.

events.note: Built 1921 as a steel Aermotor tower (FFLOS)
Towerman Erwin Wispell reported 43 forest-fire calls from the tower by April 1930
Largest fire that spring, about a week before the April 2, 1930 item, burned roughly 200 acres on Luzerne Mountain for ten hours

Aug 30, 1948 item: district office said it would operate eight towers from October 1; the same item lists Harvey's Tower, Dallas Township, among Luzerne County towers, without saying it was one of the eight
Reconditioned with a new roof and improved telephone facilities
Manned round the clock during a July 1962 dry spell
FFLOS says removed before 2005; the exact year is not given

resolved_conflicts.explanation: A 1947 newspaper item names Robert Lohman in charge of Harvey's tower; a 1948 item names Herbert Lohman of Trucksville. We could not tell which is right, so the story names neither.

notes_for_editor: The newspaper items are quoted on Forest Lookouts and were not checked against the original papers. The register gives no coordinates; the record's coordinates come from the Forest Lookouts map and were not verified. The 1962 staffing line is a dry-spell measure, not a standing crew. A WebSearch turned up nothing about the tower itself. The Irem Temple Country Club founding year (1921 per a search snippet) is not used; the listing says 1922.
